results.title: When was the last time it rained in NYC?
results.content:
According to the National Weather Service, the last time precipitation was recorded in the New York City metro area was Sept. 27.

The dry spell could potentially end this week as scattered showers are forecasted for Friday. However, if the forecast changes, New York City may see a new record for consecutive days without precipitation.

What is the record? [...] The longest record of days without precipitation in New York City since 1869 is 36 days, according to the National Weather Service. The record was set in the autumn of 1924.

The ongoing drought is now the second-longest stretch without rainfall, surpassing the 28-day drought recorded in 1941.

What happens if it doesn’t rain this week? [...] # Could NYC see a new record for days without rain?

NEW YORK (PIX11) — Very dry conditions around New York City have raised concerns, specifically the high risk of fire starting or spreading due to high winds.

The dry conditions have caused multiple wildfires, including one that burned nearly 200 acres and led to an evacuation in Livingston, New Jersey, on Saturday.
